intuition: Search and report each need only the cheapest five current records, while updates are easiest to validate lazily.

brute_force.approach: Scan every shop copy for a movie and every rented copy for each query, then sort.
brute_force.time: search/report O(n log n), rent/drop O(1)

optimal.approach: Keep availability heaps per movie and one rented heap, with a current rented-state map to discard stale heap entries.
optimal.time: rent/drop O(log n), search/report O(k log n) amortized for k returned items

edge_cases: Search returns at most five unrented shops.
Price ties sort by shop, then rented reports also by movie ID.
